message.mitofus.vrhelmet.no_room: No room to lie down here: stand on a clear, solid spot
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.starter_free: You were given a basic helmet to get started.
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.character_unrea: Your stored character from the other world cannot be read: not crossing so you do not lose your items.
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.too_tired: Too tired to connect: energy %s %%, minimum %s %%. Rest in the real world.
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.disconnected_ti: Disconnected for safety: your connection time ran out
message.mitofus.fatigue.countdown: Safety disconnection in %s s: you cannot move, attack or build
message.mitofus.fatigue.skill_refused: You cannot use attack skills during the safety protocol
message.mitofus.fatigue_display.auto: Energy: shown only while not full
hud.mitofus.fatigue_grace.title: Safety protocol
hud.mitofus.fatigue_grace.frozen: You cannot move, attack or build
hud.mitofus.fatigue_grace.safe: Nothing can hurt you until you disconnect
screen.mitofus.fatigue.tooltip: With this energy you last: resting ~%s min, playing ~%s min, fighting ~%s min. It refills in the real world (%s min from empty to full) and by sleeping. The helmet needs at least %s %%.
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.nowhere: The helmet cannot find where to connect you (this world has no Mitofus ready)
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.only_overworld: The helmet only connects from the overworld
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.bound: The helmet is now bound to you: nobody else can use it
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.unbound: Helmet unbound for %s: the first person who uses it becomes its owner
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.unbind_no_money: Unbinding this helmet costs %s and you don't have that much
tooltip.mitofus.vrhelmet_bound: Bound to its owner. Use it on a terminal to unbind it (for a fee).
Unbinding a bound helmet at the terminal costs this percent of the price of its tier (200 = double, on purpose). 0 = free. Paid with the coins of your purse.
mitofus.configuration.basicReferencePric: Iron the basic helmet counts as worth (1 gold = 100 iron) when pricing its unbinding.
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.no_mitofus: This world has no Mitofus (only new worlds have it)
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.crossing_blocke: You cannot travel between the real world and Mitofus that way: use the helmet
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.bed_ignored: Beds in Mitofus do not set your respawn
message.mitofus.character.cursor_dropped: The item on your cursor did not fit in your inventory and fell to the ground
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.logout_in_dange: You cannot disconnect while in danger
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.logout_quest_de: You can't disconnect: «%s» has a deadline running.
screen.mitofus.logout_forced: If you disconnect now you will lose the quest and its penalties.
message.mitofus.vrhelmet.logout_in_cave: There is no way out of this cave
item.mitofus.apprentice_contract.desc: Use it on the ground next to a smithing anvil. He takes materials from the chests touching the anvil and leaves what he forges in a barrel touching it, or in the containers you assign him. Right-click: empty-handed, his window; with gold coins, his wage (%s gold a day); with an item, his order.
message.mitofus.apprentice_paid_enough: %s's wage is already paid well ahead.
message.mitofus.apprentice_no_gold: You need %s gold for a day of wage.
message.mitofus.apprentice_assign_materi: Right-click the container %s will take materials from (at most %s blocks from the anvil).
message.mitofus.apprentice_assign_output: Right-click the container %s will leave his work in (at most %s blocks from the anvil).
message.mitofus.apprentice_assign_far: That container is too far from %s's anvil (%s blocks at most).
message.mitofus.apprentice_assign_cleare: %s goes back to the containers touching the anvil.
message.mitofus.apprentice_stage_too_low: %s hasn't mastered that material yet: he must be %s.
notification.mitofus.apprentice.named: %s has a gold name: he is a named NPC and will grow without limit.
notification.mitofus.apprentice.craftsma: %s forged a masterpiece and has been recognised as a Craftsman.
notification.mitofus.apprentice.illumina: Watching you forge a Legendary piece, %s reached illumination: he is a Craftsman now.
screen.mitofus.apprentice.pay_tooltip: Costs %s a day. Shift pays 5 days and Ctrl 10; if the coins fall short, it pays the days you can. Up to %s days ahead.
screen.mitofus.apprentice.dismiss_messag: He will stop working for you and leave. The contract is not given back.
screen.mitofus.apprentice.hint: To give him an order, right-click him with the item in hand. With gold coins in hand you pay several days at once (%s gold a day). Sneak while looking at him to observe him: the more View, the more you see.
message.mitofus.apprentice_max: You already have %s apprentices, the most allowed.
message.mitofus.apprentice_needs_level: You need smithing %s for another apprentice.
message.mitofus.apprentice_hired: %s is your apprentice. Put him by a smithing anvil with a chest and a barrel touching it, and give him an order. Right-click him empty-handed for his window.
message.mitofus.smith_apprentice: Ferrán el Herrero: "There's a lad in the village with good hands. Teach him what you know... and pay him every day. Here's his contract."
item.mitofus.appraiser_eye.desc: A very expensive appraisal item. With unappraised equipment in your other hand it reveals %s to %s data; otherwise it appraises the unappraised item in your inventory.
item.mitofus.orbe_aurifero.effect: Whoever reads it becomes Heir of Sancho II, the legendary blacksmith.
item.mitofus.orbe_aurifero.warning: Using it changes your level and stats.
screen.mitofus.read_orbe.message: You will become Heir of Sancho II. You go back to level 1, lose your stat points and your class skills, and get 20 extra points. This can't be undone. Read it?
item.mitofus.unappraised.tooltip: Needs appraisal to reveal its effects.
item.mitofus.guadalete_blueprint.desc: Only Heir of Sancho II can use it: at the anvil, with 15 azurite ingots. Used up by the forge.
message.mitofus.residence.set: You are now a resident of %s: you will come back to life here when you die in Mitofus.
message.mitofus.residence.same: You are already a resident of %s.
message.mitofus.residence.cooldown: You can change your residence in %s min.
tooltip.mitofus.enhance_material.loss: If it fails, the piece loses %s levels
tooltip.mitofus.enhance_material.no_loss: If it fails, the piece loses no levels
tooltip.mitofus.enhance_material.ancient: Guaranteed success: gains %s to %s levels, also on Ancestral items
tooltip.mitofus.enhance_material.loss_on: If it fails, the piece loses %s level
tooltip.mitofus.partly_appraised: Partly appraised: rating and options activate once fully appraised
tooltip.mitofus.value_unappraised: True value: %s (sells as Normal until appraised)
stat.mitofus.strength.desc: Per point: +%s attack damage. Boosts area skill damage.
stat.mitofus.intelligence.desc: Per point: +%s max mana and +%s mana per second.
stat.mitofus.dexterity.desc: Per point: +%s%% attack speed. Improves forging ratings and enhancement odds.
item.mitofus.smithing_hammer.desc: In either hand, it improves the rating of what you forge (with two, the better one counts). You can also give it to an apprentice from his window. Each piece wears it a little.
screen.mitofus.apprentice.hammer_tooltip: Give: hand him your best smithing hammer. Take: he gives it back.
screen.mitofus.workshop.empty: No apprentices yet. At smithing %s, talk to Ferrán el Herrero in Covadonga: he will give you the first contract.
message.mitofus.workshop_far: %s is too far away to open his window.
screen.mitofus.workshop.tip.stale: Out of reach: this is not live news
item.mitofus.workshop_ledger.desc: Use it to see your apprentices: what they do, their orders and their wage.
screen.mitofus.npc_no_quests: I have nothing for you right now.
rumor.mitofus.north_cave: My father used to say a legendary blacksmith spent his last years in a cave in the far north. Nobody has managed to find it.
rumor.mitofus.singing_anvil: Some days the anvil sings. A perfect strike draws more from the metal than it promised.
rumor.mitofus.an_apprentice: A true smith does not work alone. Once your hammer is worth enough, someone will want to learn from you.
rumor.mitofus.white_metal: The old miners speak of a white metal, light as a feather, hidden in the stone.
rumor.mitofus.night_calls: The guards say whoever hunts enough skeletons ends up hearing something in the night nobody else hears.
rumor.mitofus.the_earl: Conde Nuño does not receive just anyone, but they say he pays well to those who have proven themselves at the forge.
rumor.mitofus.old_smith_of_eibar: I have an old friend in Éibar, Maese Velasco. He was the best blacksmith in the region until the Compañía de Levante took his customers. Someone with Sancho II's legacy might give him back the will to forge.
rumor.mitofus.eibar_drunk: In Éibar they say old Maese Velasco doesn't forge any more: he spends the day drinking in his ruined smithy and throws out anyone who walks in.
rumor.mitofus.hidden_talents: There is more talent in Covadonga than meets the eye. It takes a good eye to see who is worth it.
rumor.mitofus.moonlit_ore: My smiths would give a year of wages for azurite. They say it is born of moonlight, deep beneath the forests.
rumor.mitofus.old_relics: An unappraised old item is a mystery. Bring it to me as it is: appraising it would only bring you trouble.
rumor.mitofus.unchosen_paths: Some paths nobody chooses. They are earned... or they find you.
rumor.mitofus.breathing_bellows: A good bellows does not blow: it breathes. Whoever finds its rhythm takes more metal out of the smelter than they put in.
rumor.mitofus.moon_hunters: The guards who hunt under the moon come back changed. They say the night rewards those who do not fear it.
rumor.mitofus.watchful_eyes: A noble looks before speaking. Whoever learns to observe people ends up seeing what nobody tells them.
screen.mitofus.no_quests_story: No quests to do right now.
screen.mitofus.quest_track_tooltip: Show this quest on the HUD panel (up to %s).
screen.mitofus.confirm_class_first: Claiming this quest will give you the class %s in your first free slot. This can't be undone. Continue?
screen.mitofus.choose_class: Choose one for slot %s (it can't be changed):
screen.mitofus.no_titles: You have no titles yet. They are earned without warning.
screen.mitofus.xp_rate.tooltip: Level XP earned over your last %s minutes played in Mitofus, scaled to an hour. It pauses outside Mitofus and while offline; it needs at least 1 minute. All level XP counts: monsters, animals and quests.
screen.mitofus.xp_rate.tooltip.passive: Animals and other peaceful mobs give less XP from level %s and just 1 XP from level %s. Villagers give no XP.
screen.mitofus.xp_rate.tooltip.step: Animals and other peaceful mobs give just 1 XP from level %s. Villagers give no XP.
screen.mitofus.no_skills: You don't know any skill yet. Read a skill book.
screen.mitofus.enhance.risk: If it fails, it loses %s levels: it would drop to +%s.
screen.mitofus.enhance.risk_one: If it fails, it loses %s level: it would drop to +%s.
screen.mitofus.enhance.safe: If it fails, it loses no levels.
screen.mitofus.enhance.wrong_weapon: This piece is a weapon: use a weapon stone or scroll.
screen.mitofus.enhance.wrong_armor: This piece is armor: use an armor stone or scroll.
screen.mitofus.enhance.wrong_hammer: This hammer is enhanced with a weapon stone or scroll.
screen.mitofus.enhance.unknown: Unappraised: the real chance depends on the hidden rating.
screen.mitofus.anvil_great_success_note: The piece comes out one rating higher
screen.mitofus.forge_auto.tooltip: Automatic forging: takes a few seconds depending on your smithing and DEX. Normal odds.
screen.mitofus.forge_auto.contest: In the contest only manual forging counts.
screen.mitofus.forge_manual.tooltip: Manual forging: heat the metal and hammer it. Done well, a better rating and maybe an extra option; done badly, worse than automatic. Double smithing XP.
screen.mitofus.recipe.tooltip: These items make more than one thing. Click to change what the anvil forges.
screen.mitofus.batch.tooltip: Batch forging: Auto forges this many in a row, each with its own rating. Click to change the amount.
screen.mitofus.batch.locked: Batch forging: unlocked at smithing level 10.
screen.mitofus.smelter_auto.tooltip: Lights the fire and melts one piece after another once it is hot enough. May give an extra ingot by your smithing level. Heating up from cold burns fuel twice as fast.
screen.mitofus.smelter_fire.tooltip: Douses the fire at once: the burning piece of fuel is lost and the smelter starts to cool.
screen.mitofus.smelter_bellows.tooltip: Melts one piece by hand with the bellows. If it is cold, it lights the fire first and tells you when it is ready. Done well: faster, maybe an extra ingot and double smithing XP; overheat it or let it cool and some metal ends up as slag.
minigame.mitofus.title: Manual forging
minigame.mitofus.heat: Hold (click or space) to heat and release when the temperature is in the golden band
minigame.mitofus.hammer: Strike (click or space) when the marker crosses the middle · %s/%s
minigame.mitofus.smelt_pump: Click or press space to pump the bellows and keep the metal in the golden zone.
class.mitofus.swordsman.desc: Melee fighter with a blade. Starts with Heavy Strike.
class.mitofus.spearman.desc: Keeps enemies at a distance. Starts with Rending Slash.
class.mitofus.squire.desc: Sturdy defender. Starts with War Cry.
class.mitofus.archer.desc: Agile ranged fighter with sharp night eyes.
class.mitofus.mage.desc: More mana and ranged spells. Starts with Flame Bolt and Mana Shield.
class.mitofus.necromancer.desc: Master of dark arts and a deep mana reserve.
job.mitofus.blacksmith.desc: Forges better gear and takes hits. Starts with Iron Guard.
job.mitofus.tailor.desc: Sews and mends cloth and leather.
job.mitofus.farmer.desc: Works the land and feeds the village.
job.mitofus.fisher.desc: Lives off rivers and the sea.
job.mitofus.legendary_blacksmith.desc: Legendary job. Great dexterity and far better smithing. Obtained through the quest Legacy of Sancho II.
title.mitofus.apprentice_smith.desc: You have forged 5 items at the anvil.
title.mitofus.epic_forger.desc: You have forged an item of Epic rating or better.
quest.mitofus.zombie_plague.desc: Zombies prowl around the village. Repeatable.
quest.mitofus.first_commission.desc: Ferrán el Herrero trusts you with your first real commission: forge any item at the anvil.
quest.mitofus.quality_test.desc: Ferrán el Herrero wants to see whether your first commission was luck. Forge two Rare or better items, automatically or by hand: both count.
quest.mitofus.call_of_the_night.desc: So many broken bones have not gone unnoticed. Something in the dark is watching you: hunt 15 more skeletons and answer its call. Replaces your current class.
quest.mitofus.night_watch.desc: You held the zombies back. Now the chief asks you to deal with the skeletons that prowl the village at night.
quest.mitofus.watch_commander.desc: Covadonga has nobody to lead its watch. Clear the surroundings of zombies and the chief will hand you the Commander's Sword: they say whoever wields it learns to read people.
quest.mitofus.covadonga_talents.desc: The chief lends you the Ruler's Sword, carried only by a recognised lord, to look for hidden talents among Covadonga's residents. Use it (right-click) near them. You give it back when you finish.
item.mitofus.commanders_sword.desc: The sword of whoever leads the soldiers. It helps to notice people.
item.mitofus.rulers_sword.desc: Only given to a recognised lord. Used to watch soldiers and residents closely.
item.mitofus.view_sword.observation: Character Observation: observe %s %% faster and see as with +%s View
item.mitofus.view_sword.talent_search: Talent Search (right-click): reveals hidden talents and named NPCs nearby; each new talent found raises View by 2
item.mitofus.loaned: Lent for "%s": given back when it ends
message.mitofus.quest_loaned: You have been lent what you need for "%s".
message.mitofus.quest_loan_returned: You give back what was lent to you for "%s".
quest.mitofus.path_of_the_adventurer.des: Prove your progress and receive a skill book.
quest.mitofus.smith_firewood.desc: Ferrán el Herrero doesn't teach the trade to just anyone. Prove you can work: bring him 64 logs for the forge.
quest.mitofus.smith_iron.desc: The forge is lit, but there is no metal. Dig in the mountain mine and bring Ferrán el Herrero 32 raw iron (or the ores).
quest.mitofus.smith_wolfram_ingots.desc: Ferrán el Herrero teaches you to smelt wolfram. Mine wolfram ore, smelt it and hand him 8 ingots.
quest.mitofus.smith_wolfram_sword.desc: Time to forge: with two wolfram ingots and a stick, forge a Wolfram sword at the anvil.
quest.mitofus.giver.blacksmith: Talk to Ferrán el Herrero in Covadonga
quest.mitofus.sancho_legacy.desc: Read the Auriferous Orb to become Heir of Sancho II. No conditions.
quest.mitofus.giver.conde_nuno: Talk to Conde Nuño at his manor
quest.mitofus.giver.velasco: Talk to Maese Velasco at his smithy in Éibar
quest.mitofus.nuno_secret_request.desc: Find the Auriferous Orb in the Altamira Cave, far to the north of Covadonga (the earl's map marks it), and bring it to him unopened. Nobody must know.
quest.mitofus.nuno_anger.desc: You appraised the book the earl wanted for himself. Nuño, a level 300 great magician, and his knights are hunting you. To be free of them, kill Conde Nuño.
title.mitofus.became_legend.desc: You read the Auriferous Orb. You sometimes resist harmful effects and, once every 5 minutes, a killing blow leaves you at 1 health.
title.mitofus.noble_scourge.desc: You killed Conde Nuño. Nobles despise you; some commoners admire you. Your mind carries the weight.
title.mitofus.night_stalker.desc: You have slain 50 monsters at night.
title.mitofus.tireless_forger.desc: You have forged 50 items at the anvil.
title.mitofus.anvil_blessed.desc: The anvil has granted you three great successes.
title.mitofus.bellows_master.desc: You have won 10 extra ingots with the smelter's bellows.
title.mitofus.keen_eye.desc: You have gained 20 View points by observing.
title.mitofus.talent_scout.desc: You have found 3 people with hidden talent.
quest.mitofus.moonlit_hunt.desc: The night no longer scares you, and something in it has noticed. Slay 10 zombies at night to prove the dark is your ground.
quest.mitofus.perfect_bellows.desc: The metal gave you more than it promised. Keep the same rhythm and win 5 extra ingots with the smelter's bellows.
quest.mitofus.smiths_gaze.desc: You have begun to see what others overlook. Observe calmly and gain 10 more View points.
quest.mitofus.steady_hand.desc: One great success may be luck; three Epic pieces are not. Forge 3 items of Epic rating or better.
goal.mitofus.milestone.bellows_extra: Win %s extra ingots with the bellows
goal.mitofus.forge_rating: Forge %s items of %s rating or better
skill.mitofus.sancho_link.desc: Fan-shaped slash in front of you. Scales with STR and DEX. Needs a sword.
skill.mitofus.bisection.desc: A long, straight cut that splits whatever is in front of you. Scales with STR. Only with a Legendary Failure in hand, on the weapon skill key.
skill.mitofus.iron_guard.desc: Resistance II and absorption for a few seconds.
skill.mitofus.flame_bolt.desc: Throws three small fireballs where you look.
skill.mitofus.heavy_strike.desc: Frontal blow on one target with extra damage and knockback. Scales with STR. Needs a sword.
skill.mitofus.rending_slash.desc: A short slash that makes enemies bleed (Bleeding II). Requires a sword.
notification.mitofus.title: You have earned a title
notification.mitofus.item.unappraised: It needs appraisal to reveal its effects.
notification.mitofus.quest_discovered: You have discovered a hidden quest
message.mitofus.wrong_item: %s: can't be used with what you are holding
message.mitofus.smelter_manual_lost: The melt was lost: the metal or the heat changed
message.mitofus.manual_refused: The result didn't count: it came too fast or too late
message.mitofus.smelter_no_fuel: There is no fuel to light the fire
message.mitofus.smelter_heating: Lit: heating up to %s° for the bellows…
message.mitofus.cave_relic: The system won't let you take anything from this place.
message.mitofus.nothing_to_appraise: You have nothing unappraised in your other hand or your inventory.
notification.mitofus.appraisal_complete: Appraisal complete: its rating and options are now active
notification.mitofus.appraisal_partial: Some data is still hidden: appraise it again
message.mitofus.debug_appraisal_not_equi: Hold rated equipment in your main hand
message.mitofus.debug_appraisal_complete: The piece is now fully appraised
message.mitofus.nuno_nobody: Conde Nuño: "I have no time for a nobody. Come back when Ferrán el Herrero thinks something of you."
message.mitofus.nuno_secret: Conde Nuño: "I have heard of you, blacksmith. I have a... discreet request. Take this map."
message.mitofus.nuno_thief: Conde Nuño: "Thief! That book is mine."
message.mitofus.smith_tells_of_velasco: Ferrán el Herrero: "So now you carry Sancho II's legacy... An old friend of mine, Maese Velasco, lives in Éibar. He was an excellent blacksmith, but the Compañía de Levante ruined him and now he only drinks. Take this map: maybe you can help him."
message.mitofus.velasco_drunk.1: Maese Velasco: "Another customer? Nothing gets forged here any more. Go away."
message.mitofus.velasco_drunk.2: Maese Velasco: "Leave me alone... *hic*... the Compañía de Levante has taken everything."
message.mitofus.velasco_drunk.3: Maese Velasco: "Out of my smithy. If you want a hammer, buy one from the Levante."
message.mitofus.nuno_arrives: Conde Nuño: "I knew someone as ordinary as you would find it... and that greed would open it. Give it to me."
message.mitofus.nuno_took_book: Conde Nuño took the Auriferous Orb.
message.mitofus.read_orbe: You read the Auriferous Orb. You are now Heir of Sancho II... and back at level 1.
message.mitofus.sancho_book_already_read: You already know everything this book can teach you.
message.mitofus.legend_saved: "One Who Became a Legend": you held on against death.
message.mitofus.smelter_ready: The smelter is ready for the bellows
message.mitofus.smelter_extra: A pure melt! An extra ingot
message.mitofus.enhance_no_chance: Too powerful for this material: it needs an ancient scroll.
message.mitofus.requirements_unmet: You don't meet this item's requirements
message.mitofus.death_xp_lost: You died and lost %s XP from your current level
message.mitofus.quest_tracking_full: You already follow %s quests on the HUD
message.mitofus.respec_done: Points refunded: you have %s to spend
message.mitofus.respec_nothing: You have no allocated points to refund
message.mitofus.simulate_not_a_mob: That entity is not a mob
message.mitofus.simulate_not_counted: %s gives no XP and does not count as a kill
message.mitofus.debug_xp: Level %s · %s/%s XP · %s to go (~%s) · %s XP/hour (%s s measured, %s min window)
message.mitofus.debug_smithing: Smithing set to level %s (effective, with the class: %s)
message.mitofus.help.logout: leaves Mitofus safely after a short countdown
message.mitofus.help.validate: checks the loaded content (use it after /reload)
message.mitofus.help.set: sets level, class (by name, optional slot 1-3), class level, grade, job, stats, smithing, iron, fatigue or View
message.mitofus.help.xp: shows level, XP and the XP per hour
message.mitofus.help.give: gives XP, test equipment, a grade up, talents, a skill, a passive or a quest completed
message.mitofus.help.reset: clears the character, quests, talents, the XP measure, passives, trade pressure, the death record or the terminal offer
message.mitofus.help.remove: takes away a passive given by command
message.mitofus.help.mastery: shows or sets the mastery level or uses of a skill
message.mitofus.help.appraisal: unappraises, reveals or completes the appraisal of the piece in hand
message.mitofus.help.terminal: shows the terminal: stored gold, work order and today's offer
message.mitofus.help.trade: lists the trade pressure of each good
message.mitofus.help.death: shows the death record and the reconnection lock
message.mitofus.help.fatigue: shows or hides the fatigue panel
message.mitofus.help.vrhelmet: shows the helmet or changes its tier, rest or cooldown, or disconnects
message.mitofus.help.spawn: spawns a leveled mob or an apprentice in front of you
message.mitofus.help.goto: takes you to a place or structure
message.mitofus.help.simulate: posts kills or forged items as real play would
message.mitofus.debug_no_class: No class called '%s' (or you are not in Mitofus)
message.mitofus.class_slot_locked: That class slot is not unlocked yet
message.mitofus.class_slot_taken: That slot already has a class; what is chosen is not changed
message.mitofus.class_duplicate: You already have that class in another slot
message.mitofus.class_bad_slot: That class slot does not exist
message.mitofus.class_reward_no_slot: You have no free class slot, so the class %s was not added. More slots unlock as you level up.
message.mitofus.debug_no_class_slot: There is no class in slot %s
message.mitofus.debug_class_not_placed: %s is not one of your placed classes
message.mitofus.debug_talent_buyall: Bought %2$s talent nodes of %1$s (raised its level and grade as needed)
message.mitofus.debug_grade_no_class: There is no class in slot %s
message.mitofus.debug_grade_max: That class is already at the highest grade
message.mitofus.debug_grade_level: The class has not reached the level for the next grade yet
message.mitofus.debug_grade_job: You lack the job level for the next grade
message.mitofus.debug_no_job: No job called '%s' (or you are not in Mitofus)
message.mitofus.debug_passive_cleared: Passives back to what the class gives
message.mitofus.debug_skill_not_learned: Could not learn %s (it does not exist or you already know it)
message.mitofus.debug_mastery_none: You have not learned any skill
message.mitofus.debug_mastery_not_learne: Note: %s is not learned yet, its mastery does not count until you learn it (/mitofus give skill)
message.mitofus.debug_gear_bonus: %s: sword that requires %s points and chestplate with +%s
message.mitofus.debug_goto_none: This world has no %s (only new worlds have one)
message.mitofus.debug_goto_sea: %s is in the sea: there is no dry ground there to land on
message.mitofus.debug_quest_complete: Quest %s completed (%s quests marked done; rewards only for the requested quest)
message.mitofus.debug_apprentice_refused: No apprentice: raise smithing first (/mitofus set smithing)
screen.mitofus.view.tooltip: Not allocated with points: it grows by observing. Sneak while looking at an NPC or a monster for %s seconds (each one teaches once a day; the more View, the quicker). The more View, the more Character Observation shows you.
notification.mitofus.view.medium: You now see your apprentices' level, fail chance and pace.
notification.mitofus.view.high: You now see NPC grades and how far they can grow.
quest.mitofus.velascos_rage.desc: Help Maese Velasco, who fell for the Compañía de Levante's tricks and lost his customers: drive the Levante's thugs out of his smithy and destroy the transfer contract. You have 7 days, or Maese Velasco will die.
goal.mitofus.milestone.contract_destroye: Drive off the thugs and tear up the transfer contract
message.mitofus.quest_failed_levels: You lose %s level(s) for failing the quest.
message.mitofus.quest_cannot_abandon: A quest against the clock can't be abandoned.
notification.mitofus.fatigue_warning.bod: You have %s %% of your energy left.
notification.mitofus.fatigue_exhausted.b: Safety protocol: you cannot move, attack or build. The system will disconnect you in a few seconds.
notification.mitofus.quest_warning.body: Less than a day left to complete it.
skill.mitofus.blacksmith_rage.desc: The rage of a trampled blacksmith: +10% attack for 30 seconds.
item.mitofus.transfer_contract.desc: The contract that would hand Maese Velasco's smithy to the Compañía de Levante. Right-click to tear it up.
message.mitofus.contract_torn: You tear the transfer contract to pieces. Maese Velasco's smithy won't belong to the Levante.
message.mitofus.levante_thugs_arrive: Compañía de Levante thugs burst into the smithy! "Sign it already, you old drunk..."
message.mitofus.velascos_rage_done: Maese Velasco: "...Thank you. Nobody has stood by me in years. No more drinking: this smithy will ring again."
message.mitofus.velasco_sober: Maese Velasco: "Ah, it's you! Come in, the forge is hot again."
message.mitofus.velasco_lost: Maese Velasco won't speak to you. You failed him when he needed you most.
message.mitofus.velasco_died: The days went by and nobody stopped the Compañía de Levante... Maese Velasco is dead. His quests are lost forever.
message.mitofus.velasco_died_for_you: The days went by and you didn't stop the Compañía de Levante. For you, Maese Velasco is finished: he won't speak to you again and his quests are lost forever.
quest.mitofus.velascos_contest.desc: The Compañía de Levante has hired Mencía to take Maese Velasco's smithy for good. Beat her in the production contest on Éibar's square: one piece forged by hand at the stage, against the clock.
goal.mitofus.milestone.contest_won: Beat Mencía in the contest on the square
title.mitofus.velascos_disciple.desc: Maese Velasco, Éibar's old blacksmith, teaches you all he knows.
screen.mitofus.velascos_contest.message: You will have %s minutes to forge a single piece by hand at the stage anvil. Maese Velasco gives you 2 wolfram ingots and a stick. Mencía is ready... Shall we begin?
message.mitofus.velascos_contest_accepte: Maese Velasco: "The Levante has hired a smith, Mencía, to take my smithy fair and square. She's waiting on the stage in the square. I'll hold the metal for you."
message.mitofus.mencia_beaten: Mencía: "...You won fair and square. Next time won't be the same."
message.mitofus.contest_go_to_velasco: Mencía: "Go to your master. You got what you wanted."
message.mitofus.mencia_tomorrow: Mencía: "You've lost today. Come back tomorrow, if you dare."
message.mitofus.contest_started: The contest begins! Maese Velasco hands you the materials. You have %s minutes: forge one piece by hand at the stage anvil.
message.mitofus.contest_by_hand: Only manual forging counts in the contest.
message.mitofus.contest_won: The square erupts in cheers. Maese Velasco: "I knew it! Come to my smithy, we need to talk."
message.mitofus.contest_lost_for_good: The judges give the win to Mencía. The Compañía de Levante keeps Maese Velasco's smithy...
message.mitofus.contest_lost_rematch: The judges give the win to Mencía. Maese Velasco: "Never mind. We'll try again tomorrow."
message.mitofus.velascos_contest_done: Maese Velasco: "From today you are my disciple. All I know is yours." Maese Velasco's smithy stands again.
message.mitofus.velasco_master: Maese Velasco: "My disciple! Come in, the forge is lit."
message.mitofus.velasco_contest_lost: Maese Velasco has gone back to drinking. The smithy belongs to the Levante now, and he wants nothing to do with you.
screen.mitofus.trade.empty: You carry no rated equipment to sell.
screen.mitofus.trade.confirm_hidden_powe: Are you sure you want to do that? Something you are selling hides a special power. Pieces: %s · You will receive %s.
screen.mitofus.trade.tip.saturation: You sold many pieces like this: the price drops and recovers over the days.
trade.mitofus.refusal.stacked: Only sold one at a time
message.mitofus.trade_stale: The piece or its price changed. Check the list and try again.
message.mitofus.trade_skipped: %s piece(s) were not sold: they or their price changed. Check the list.
message.mitofus.trade_failed: The sale could not be completed.

message.mitofus.terminal.sold_out: You already bought that piece today.

message.mitofus.vrhelmet.disconnected_de: Disconnected for safety after dying twice in a row
notification.mitofus.mitofus_death.first: You died. You respawn at your last save point and lose nothing.
notification.mitofus.mitofus_death.secon: You died twice within %s min. For your safety, the helmet disconnects you and you cannot connect again for %s min.
You died twice within %s min. For your safety, the helmet disconnects you.

message.mitofus.smith_shop.not_enough: You don't carry what it costs.
mitofus.configuration.title: %s settings
mitofus.configuration.lifeFraction.toolt: A blow from a creature that takes this fraction of the victim's maximum life at once stuns it, player or mob (0.4 = 40%.
mitofus.configuration.durationSeconds.to: Seconds a stunned creature cannot move or attack. 0 = stun is off. Duration is the mod's own design.
mitofus.configuration.immunitySeconds.to: Seconds after a stun ends in which the creature cannot be stunned again, so stuns cannot be chained. 0 = no immunity. Mod's own design.
mitofus.configuration.weightNormal.toolt: Base weight of Normal when forging or finding equipment (the six weights are relative: 86 means 86 % when they add up to 100).
mitofus.configuration.skillScale.tooltip: Skill points (dexterity + 3 x smithing level) that double the odds of each step up in rating. Higher = skill matters less.
mitofus.configuration.pityEnabled.toolti: After pityStart forges (or finds) in a row without an Epic or better, each next one gets pitySkillPerRoll extra virtual skill, up to pityCap. Counted per player and per way (forging or loot); an Epic or better resets it. It only lifts the odds up to Unique: Legendary and Ancestral never come out of it; it is meant to be a quiet nudge.
mitofus.configuration.pityStart.tooltip: How many forges (or finds) in a row without an Epic or better before the bonus starts.
mitofus.configuration.pitySkillPerRoll.t: Virtual skill added for each forge (or find) once the bonus has started.
mitofus.configuration.pityCap.tooltip: The most virtual skill the anti-bad-luck bonus can add.
mitofus.configuration.weightEnabled.tool: Weight: only smith's objects weigh. Going over the limit slows you by half the percentage over it and may weaken you. Off by default until it is tried in the game; the mod's own design.
Kilograms of smith's objects anyone can carry before slowing down.
mitofus.configuration.weightKgPerStamina: Kilograms each point of Stamina adds to the limit.
mitofus.configuration.statPointsPerLevel: Free stat points granted on each level up.
mitofus.configuration.killXpMultiplier.t: Kill XP = (max health + attack damage * killXpPerAttackDamage + armor * killXpPerArmor) * killXpMultiplier. With the defaults a zombie (20 HP, 3 attack, 2 armor) gives 28.
mitofus.configuration.killXpPerAttackDam: Weight of the mob's attack damage in the kill XP.
mitofus.configuration.killXpPerArmor.too: Weight of the mob's armor in the kill XP.
mitofus.configuration.spawnerXpMultiplie: Kill XP multiplier for mobs that came from a spawner or trial spawner (anti-farming).
mitofus.configuration.xpBase.tooltip: XP to the next level = xpBase + xpPerLevel * current level.
mitofus.configuration.xpPerLevel.tooltip: How much the XP needed grows with each level.
mitofus.configuration.passiveFullXpUntil: Full XP from peaceful mobs until level

Peaceful mobs (animals and the like) give their normal XP up to this player level; from there it falls in a straight line to 1 XP at passiveOneXpFromLevel. It does not affect monsters, neutral mobs or bosses. Villagers give no XP.
mitofus.configuration.passiveOneXpFromLe: 1 XP from peaceful mobs from level
From this player level on, peaceful mobs give 1 XP. If it is not above passiveFullXpUntilLevel the drop is a single step.
mitofus.configuration.manaPerIntelligenc: Max mana each point of Intelligence gives.
mitofus.configuration.baseManaRegen.tool: Mana per second = baseManaRegen + manaRegenPerIntelligence * INT.
mitofus.configuration.manaRegenPerIntell: Mana per second each point of Intelligence gives.
mitofus.configuration.baseChance.tooltip: Success chance = baseChance - chanceLossPerLevel * current level + chancePerDexterity * DEX, clamped between minChance and baseChance.
mitofus.configuration.chanceLossPerLevel: How much the chance drops for each enhancement level the piece already has.
mitofus.configuration.chancePerDexterity: How much the chance rises for each point of Dexterity.
mitofus.configuration.minChance.tooltip: The success chance never goes below this.
mitofus.configuration.normalStoneFailLos: Levels a piece loses when an enhancement with a normal stone fails (never below +0). 3.
mitofus.configuration.blessedStoneFailLo: Levels lost when an enhancement with a blessed stone fails. 1.
mitofus.configuration.blessedScrollFailL: Levels lost when an enhancement with the blessed scroll fails. 0.
mitofus.configuration.bonusPerLevel.tool: Each enhancement level below bonusHighFromLevel raises the item's base attack (weapons) or base armor (armor) by this fraction, compounding (0.05 = 5%%).
The same for each level from bonusHighFromLevel on (0.07 = 7%%).
mitofus.configuration.bonusHighFromLevel: First enhancement level that uses bonusPerLevelHigh.
mitofus.configuration.chanceFactorNormal: Success chance of stones and the blessed scroll is multiplied by the factor of the piece's rank (the mod's own design). 0 in a rank = only the ancient scroll works on it.
mitofus.configuration.ancientScrollMinGa: Fewest levels an ancient scroll adds (it never fails; the mod's own design). If min is above max, the two swap.
mitofus.configuration.ancientScrollMaxGa: Most levels an ancient scroll adds.
mitofus.configuration.boneLordAncientScr: Chance the Bone Lord drops an ancient scroll when a player kills it (the mod's own design).
mitofus.configuration.xpLoss.tooltip: Fraction of the current level's XP lost on death (0.1 = 10%%). Never drops a level. 0 by default.
mitofus.configuration.doubleDeathWindowM: A second death in Mitofus within this many in-game minutes (game time, stops while the server is closed) of the previous one also disconnects you to your helmet. 0 = never. Own design (24 h).
mitofus.configuration.reconnectLockMinut: After that double-death disconnection you cannot connect to Mitofus again for this many in-game minutes (game time, stops while the server is closed). 0 = no lock. Fatigue and normal logouts never lock. Own design.
mitofus.configuration.pvpDropChance: Chance to drop pieces when killed by a player
mitofus.configuration.pvpDropChance.tool: Chance (0.05 = 5 %) that dying in Mitofus to another player, with PvP on, makes equipped pieces fall where you died, for whoever picks them up. 0 = never.
mitofus.configuration.pvpDropCount: Pieces that drop when killed by a player
mitofus.configuration.pvpDropCount.toolt: How many equipped pieces (main hand and the four armor pieces) fall when that happens.
mitofus.configuration.levelSpread.toolti: Hostile mobs spawn at the nearest player's level, plus or minus up to this many levels.
mitofus.configuration.healthPerLevel.too: Extra max health per level above 1, as a fraction of the base (0.08 = +8%%).
mitofus.configuration.damagePerLevel.too: Extra attack damage per level above 1, as a fraction of the base.
mitofus.configuration.eliteChance.toolti: Chance for a hostile mob to be an elite: glowing, +eliteStatBonus health and damage, eliteXpMultiplier XP.
mitofus.configuration.eliteStatBonus.too: Extra health and damage of an elite, as a fraction of the base.
What an elite's XP is multiplied by.
mitofus.configuration.eliteEquipmentChan: Chance for an elite killed by a player to drop a rated piece from the #mitofus:elite_drops tag. Material and quality depend on the elite's level.
mitofus.configuration.eliteDropMinChance: The chance of an elite's equipment drop falls with its level (no level cap) and tends to this floor. eliteEquipmentChance is the chance at level 1.
mitofus.configuration.eliteDropDecay.too: Each level above 1, what is left of the chance above its floor is multiplied by this (0.92 = 8% less per level; 1.0 = it never falls).
mitofus.configuration.smithLevel.tooltip: Level shown for Ferrán el Herrero, the village blacksmith
mitofus.configuration.chiefLevel.tooltip: Level shown for the village chief (own design)
mitofus.configuration.contestLoss.toolti: Losing the production contest against Mencía in Éibar: FAIL closes the quest for good, REMATCH allows another try the next game day, AUTO fails it in a single-player world and gives a rematch in a shared one.
mitofus.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Fatigue: a bar that drains only in Mitofus and refills in the real world. When it runs out the helmet disconnects you. These numbers are.
mitofus.configuration.sessionMinutes.too: Real minutes of normal play from full energy to empty.
mitofus.configuration.restMultiplier.too: Share of the normal drain paid while standing still.
mitofus.configuration.combatMultiplier.t: Multiplier of the normal drain while fighting (damage given or taken in the last 10 seconds). Working at an anvil or a smelter costs the same.
mitofus.configuration.forgeCostSeconds.t: Seconds of normal play that each forged item costs.
mitofus.configuration.recoveryMinutes.to: Real minutes to go from empty to full while resting in the real world.
mitofus.configuration.minEnergyToConnect: The helmet refuses to connect below this energy (0 to 1).
mitofus.configuration.graceSeconds.toolt: Seconds between running out of energy and the forced disconnection.
mitofus.configuration.restraintLeeway.to: Blocks a player held in the grace period may drift before the server puts them back.
mitofus.configuration.warnFirst.tooltip: Energies (0 to 1) at which a warning shows once when crossed downwards.
mitofus.configuration.warnSecond.tooltip: Energy of the second warning (0 to 1).
mitofus.configuration.warnThird.tooltip: Energy of the third warning (0 to 1).
mitofus.configuration.sleepRecovery.tool: Energy (0 to 1) that sleeping through the night in the real world gives back.
mitofus.configuration.basePriceGoldNorma: Trade: selling equipment for gold. These numbers are. Reference price in gold of a piece of each rating; the price is this x material x level x options x enhancement x durability (this one: normal).
Reference price of a rare piece.
Reference price of a epic piece.
mitofus.configuration.basePriceGoldUniqu: Reference price of a unique piece.
mitofus.configuration.basePriceGoldLegen: Reference price of a legendary piece.
mitofus.configuration.basePriceGoldAnces: Reference price of a ancestral piece.
mitofus.configuration.otherMaterial.tool: Price multiplier of any other material.
mitofus.configuration.enhancementBonus.t: Share of the reference price added per enhancement level (every piece).
mitofus.configuration.levelBonus.tooltip: Share of the reference price added per level of the piece's required level above 1.
mitofus.configuration.optionBonus.toolti: Share of the reference price added per option the piece carries.
mitofus.configuration.impossibleMargin.t: A piece whose recipe asks for a level more than this many levels above the one its material and rating justify is "impossible".
mitofus.configuration.impossibleFactor.t: Price factor of an impossible piece (0 to 1).
mitofus.configuration.sellShare.tooltip: Share of the reference price paid in gold when selling (0 to 1: selling never pays more than the reference).
mitofus.configuration.saturationStep.too: Price factor for each point of pressure (each piece sold of the same category and rating).
mitofus.configuration.saturationFloor.to: The saturation factor never goes below this.
mitofus.configuration.recoveryPerDay.too: Points of pressure that go away each whole game day.
mitofus.configuration.maxSellGold.toolti: A sale that would pay more gold than this is refused without touching the piece.
mitofus.configuration.itemMultipliers.to: Price multiplier of single objects, "ns:path=N" (N from 0 to 100). It replaces the one of the material, so a unique object (Guadalete, the Wolfram sword, the smithing hammers) does not weigh as iron or netherite just for its tier. A wrong line is dropped when NeoForge corrects the file (and if no line is left, the default list comes back); if an item repeats, the first line wins.
mitofus.configuration.minDurabilityFacto: Price factor of a piece with no durability left (0 to 1). A new piece pays the full price; in between it is linear.
mitofus.configuration.levelWood.tooltip: The level a rated piece needs to be used, unless its recipe asks for more: the level of its material plus the extra of its rating. These numbers are. Level of wood equipment.
mitofus.configuration.extraNormal.toolti: Levels a rating adds on top of the material's (this one: normal).
mitofus.configuration.itemLevels.tooltip: Level of single objects, "ns:path=N", instead of their material's.
mitofus.configuration.buyMultiplier.tool: Account terminal: the daily offer, paid with the coins of your purse (the mod's own design). How many times its reference value a piece of the daily offer costs (price = reference x this, in gold, at least 1 gold of reference).
mitofus.configuration.offerPerRank.toolt: Pieces of the daily offer for each rating, from normal up to offerMaxRating. 0 turns the offer off.
mitofus.configuration.offerMaxRating.too: The highest rating the daily offer reaches.
mitofus.configuration.offerItems.tooltip: The item types the daily offer draws from (equipment only: unknown ids and non-equipment are skipped with a warning). The list cannot be empty (the config rejects it); to turn the offer off use offerPerRank = 0.
mitofus.configuration.minData.tooltip: Appraisal of equipment with the Appraiser Eye. Loot, the terminal's offer and apprentices' pieces come unappraised; each use of the Eye reveals some of their data. Revealing 6 to 10 data per use; the cooldown is the mod's own design. Fewest data one use of the Eye reveals (if min is above max, the two swap).
mitofus.configuration.maxData.tooltip: Most data one use of the Eye reveals.
mitofus.configuration.eyeCooldownTicks.t: Ticks before the Appraiser Eye can be used again (20 ticks = 1 second).
mitofus.configuration.advancedSessionMin: The helmet tiers (). The basic helmet uses the [fatigue] numbers as they are; if fatigue.sessionMinutes is higher than these, the advanced helmet lasts less than the basic one (not checked). Real minutes of normal play from full energy to empty with the advanced helmet.
mitofus.configuration.advancedRecoveryMi: Real minutes to refill from empty in the real world after an advanced session.
mitofus.configuration.diamondSessionMinu: Real minutes of normal play from full energy to empty with the diamond helmet.
mitofus.configuration.diamondRecoveryMin: Real minutes to refill from empty in the real world after a diamond session.
mitofus.configuration.restedMinutes.tool: Minutes of the "rested" bonus a diamond connection grants (only with enough energy). 0 turns it off.
mitofus.configuration.restedXpPercent.to: Extra level XP, in percent, while rested (smithing XP is not affected).
mitofus.configuration.restedMinEnergy.to: The energy (0 to 1) needed when connecting with the diamond helmet to get the rested bonus.
mitofus.configuration.restedCooldownMinu: Minutes spent inside Mitofus after a rested bonus is granted before connecting grants another. 0 = no wait.
mitofus.configuration.fatigueDisplay.too: How the energy bar shows: AUTO only while it is not full, ALWAYS, or HIDDEN (the warnings still show). The Mitofus fatigue key cycles through them.
mitofus.configuration.firstApprenticeLev: Apprentice blacksmiths (the mod's own design). Effective smithing level that allows the first apprentice.
mitofus.configuration.levelsPerApprentic: Smithing levels for each apprentice after the first (with the defaults: 1 at 50, 2 at 60... 5 at 90).
mitofus.configuration.maxApprentices.too: Most apprentices a smith may have. 0 turns them off (no new hires; the ones already hired stay).
mitofus.configuration.dailyWage.tooltip: Gold each apprentice costs per Minecraft day.
mitofus.configuration.maxPaidDays.toolti: Days of wage that can be paid ahead.
mitofus.configuration.contractPrice.tool: Gold Ferrán el Herrero asks for each apprentice contract after the first, which he gives.
mitofus.configuration.slowestSecondsPerP: Seconds a beginner apprentice takes per piece; each smithing level takes half a second off, down to the fastest. If slowest is below fastest, they swap.
mitofus.configuration.fastestSecondsPerP: Seconds the most skilled apprentice takes per piece.
mitofus.configuration.stonePrice.tooltip: Ferrán el Herrero's shop, prices in gold. A smith already in the world takes the new numbers the next time his shop opens, keeping what was already bought. Weapon or armor enhancement stone.
Blessed weapon or armor enhancement stone.
mitofus.configuration.blessedScrollPrice: Blessed enhancement scroll (the mod's own design).
mitofus.configuration.stoneStock.tooltip: Normal stones of each kind he has until he restocks.
mitofus.configuration.blessedStock.toolt: Blessed stones of each kind, and blessed scrolls, he has until he restocks.
mitofus.configuration.mithrilSaleGold.to: Gold he pays for 4 mithril ingots.
mitofus.configuration.eyePrice.tooltip: Appraiser Eye (it also asks for 2 diamonds).
mitofus.configuration.eyeDailyStock.tool: Appraiser Eyes on sale each Minecraft day.
mitofus.configuration.contestMinutes.too: Minutes of game time to forge the one piece of the contest against Mencía (the mod's own design).
mitofus.configuration.rivalMinScore.tool: Mencía's score is rolled between these two. A piece scores 100 per rating above Normal plus the precision in percent (an Epic at 87%% is 287). The defaults go from a fair Rare to a perfect Epic. If min is above max, they swap.
mitofus.configuration.connectSeconds.too: Seconds lying in a helmet before connecting to Mitofus (moving or being hurt cancels it).
mitofus.configuration.dangerSeconds.tool: Seconds after any combat during which /mitofus logout is refused. 0 = never refused.
mitofus.configuration.maxDistance.toolti: Blocks the player may get from the helmet while connecting before it is cancelled.
mitofus.configuration.stillTolerance.too: Blocks the player may move during the connection or the logout countdown and still count as standing still.
mitofus.configuration.namedChance.toolti: Chance (0 to 1) that a hired apprentice is a named NPC (grows without limit). With semiNamedChance it never passes 1.
mitofus.configuration.semiNamedChance.to: Chance (0 to 1) that a hired apprentice is semi-named (grows further than a normal one). If namedChance + this passes 1, this is cut.
mitofus.configuration.boneLordMinions.to: Skeletons the Bone Lord summons once. 0 = none.
mitofus.configuration.boneLordRegenPerce: Percent of its max health the Bone Lord heals each second when left alone (see boneLordOutOfCombatSeconds).
mitofus.configuration.boneLordOutOfComba: Seconds without being hurt before the Bone Lord starts healing.
mitofus.configuration.combatWindowSecond: Seconds after damage given or taken that still count as fighting for the fatigue (see combatMultiplier). 0 = never fighting.
Seconds of protection after a forced disconnection (nothing can hurt the player while they reconnect). 0 = none.
mitofus.configuration.restMaxMove.toolti: Blocks the player may move (measured over one tick window) and still count as standing still for restMultiplier.
Seconds after breaking a block that still count as working for the fatigue. 0 = mining never counts.
mitofus.configuration.terminalRange.tool: Blocks from the terminal beyond which its screen closes.
skill.mitofus.mana_shield.desc: Absorbs damage for a few seconds.
screen.mitofus.coach_info: Trips between the villages. Each button shows the total fare, and the road takes %s.
message.mitofus.coach.here: The coachman cannot take you there from here.
message.mitofus.coach.no_road: There is no road to that village in this world.
message.mitofus.coach.no_money: The trip costs %s and you do not carry enough.
message.mitofus.coach.arrived: You arrive at %s. The trip cost %s.
message.mitofus.storage.no_money: That costs %s and you do not carry enough.
message.mitofus.storage.not_opened: You have no storage yet: open it first.
message.mitofus.storage.full: Your storage already has all its rows.
screen.mitofus.weight.tooltip: Weight of your smith objects against your limit. Over it you move slower and may be weakened. Stamina raises the limit.
mitofus.configuration.classRankRare.tool: Multiplier of the stat bonuses of a Rare class (Normal is always 1). The mod's own design.
mitofus.configuration.classRankEpic.tool: Multiplier of the stat bonuses of an Epic class.
mitofus.configuration.classRankUnique.to: Multiplier of the stat bonuses of a Unique class.
mitofus.configuration.classRankLegendary: Multiplier of the stat bonuses of a Legendary class.
mitofus.configuration.classRankAncestral: Multiplier of the stat bonuses of a Ancestral class.
mitofus.configuration.coachBaseIron.tool: The coachman's base fare in iron (100 iron = 1 gold). gold on a safe road, so 500.
mitofus.configuration.coachSurchargeIron: Iron the surcharge for risk adds for every 100 blocks of road. The mod's own design.
mitofus.configuration.coachMaxSurchargeI: The most the surcharge can add to the fare, in iron.
mitofus.configuration.storageOpenIron.to: What opening a storage costs in iron. It comes with 2 rows (18 slots).
mitofus.configuration.storageRow3Iron.to: What the third row costs, in iron. The rows are the mod's own design.
mitofus.configuration.storageRow4Iron.to: What the fourth row costs, in iron.
mitofus.configuration.storageRow5Iron.to: What the fifth row costs, in iron.
mitofus.configuration.storageRow6Iron.to: What the sixth row costs, in iron (54 slots in all).

talent_node.mitofus.swordsman_root.desc: The start of the tree. Free: it is always yours.
talent_node.mitofus.blade_mastery_1.desc: Blade Mastery gives +3% more damage with swords and axes.
talent_node.mitofus.rending_slash.desc: Learn Rending Slash, a short slash that makes enemies bleed.
talent_node.mitofus.blade_mastery_2.desc: Blade Mastery gives +5% more damage with swords and axes.
talent_node.mitofus.master_edge.desc: +3 Strength and Heavy Strike deals 20% more damage. Needs the Adept grade.
talent_node.mitofus.iron_guard.desc: Learn Iron Guard: resistance and absorption for a few seconds.
talent_node.mitofus.immovable.desc: Tough Skin also gives knockback resistance.
talent_node.mitofus.bulwark.desc: +3 Stamina and Iron Guard recharges 20% faster. Needs the Adept grade.
talent_node.mitofus.war_cry.desc: Learn War Cry: Strength for a few seconds.
talent_node.mitofus.warlord.desc: +2 Agility, +2 Strength and War Cry recharges 20% faster. Needs the Adept grade.

class.mitofus.spellsword.desc: A fighter who weaves spells into every strike.
class.mitofus.guardian.desc: A steadfast defender who holds the line with spear and shield.
class.mitofus.arcane_marksman.desc: An archer whose arrows carry magic.
class.mitofus.paladin.desc: A sworn blade and shield, hard to bring down.
class.mitofus.warlock.desc: A caster who bends both flame and death.
class.mitofus.hunt_rider.desc: A swift hunter with bow and lance.

screen.mitofus.skill_bars_locked: Closed slot: it opens as you level up.
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_adept.desc: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Adept swordsman. slay 30 monsters.
title.mitofus.grade_adept.desc: One of your classes has reached the grade of Adept.
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_expert.des: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Expert swordsman. slay 60 monsters.
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_expert_bla: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Expert swordsman. As a blacksmith, you prove yourself in your own trade: forge 3 items of Rare rating or better.
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_expert_fis: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Expert swordsman. As a fisher, you prove yourself in your own trade: bring the chief 5 fish.
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_expert_far: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Expert swordsman. As a farmer, you prove yourself in your own trade: bring the chief 16 crops (wheat, carrots, potatoes or beetroots).
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_expert_woo: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Expert swordsman. As a woodcutter, you prove yourself in your own trade: spend 2 minutes walking through a forest.
title.mitofus.grade_expert.desc: One of your classes has reached the grade of Expert.
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_master.des: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Master swordsman. slay 100 monsters.
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_master_bla: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Master swordsman. As a blacksmith, you prove yourself in your own trade: forge 3 items of Epic rating or better.
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_master_fis: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Master swordsman. As a fisher, you prove yourself in your own trade: catch 12 fish and cook 8 items.
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_master_far: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Master swordsman. As a farmer, you prove yourself in your own trade: harvest 50 ripe crops and bake 6 loaves of bread.
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_master_woo: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Master swordsman. As a woodcutter, you prove yourself in your own trade: chop 50 logs and spend 4 minutes in a forest.
title.mitofus.grade_master.desc: One of your classes has reached the grade of Master.
quest.mitofus.grade_swordsman_grand_mast: Show the chief you have earned the grade of Grand Master swordsman. hand in 5 wolfram ingots.
title.mitofus.grade_grand_master.desc: One of your classes has reached the grade of Grand Master.
screen.mitofus.quest_grade_level_too_low: You need class level %1$s of %3$s (you are level %2$s)
screen.mitofus.quest_grade_tree_incomple: Buy every talent available at your current grade first (Talents tab)
goal.mitofus.milestone.waterside_time: Spend %s × 10 seconds by a river or the sea
